detailed_descriptions.en: VALHALL is a blend of multiple genres, combining first & third person physical combat slasher with a survival experience set in a brutal world of Vikings. Open World Survival Build and defend your settlement. Gather resources, hunt for food, and survive against the forces of nature and wildlife. Every tree can be chopped down. Craft weapons and tools. Prepare for battles against other Vikings and creatures as you raid and loot enemy camps. Physics-Responsive Combat Control the direction and type of your attacks and blocks with a fluid yet weighty Viking combat system. Dodge, slide, and unleash powerful special moves in intense melee combat. Battle Arena Step into the arena and fight relentless waves of foes, each stronger than the last. Prove your strength in this challenging game, carving a path of glory with each victory. Triumph, and the gods may deem you worthy of wielding the legendary Mjolnir. Wield Mjolnir Crush your enemies with the devastating power of Thor’s hammer. Shake the ground beneath them and send foes flying with each mighty strike. Take full control of your attacks by adjusting the distance of your Mjolnir throws in real time with precise mouse movements. Deathmatch Engage in a free-for-all battle against other warriors. More in development. Skål!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
VALHALL is a blend of multiple genres, combining first & third person physical combat slasher with a survival experience set in a brutal world of Vikings.

Open World Survival

Build and defend your settlement. Gather resources, hunt for food, and survive against the forces of nature and wildlife. Every tree can be chopped down. Craft weapons and tools. Prepare for battles against other Vikings and creatures as you raid and loot enemy camps.

Physics-Responsive Combat

Control the direction and type of your attacks and blocks with a fluid yet weighty Viking combat system. Dodge, slide, and unleash powerful special moves in intense melee combat.

Battle Arena

Step into the arena and fight relentless waves of foes, each stronger than the last. Prove your strength in this challenging game, carving a path of glory with each victory. Triumph, and the gods may deem you worthy of wielding the legendary Mjolnir.

Wield Mjolnir

Crush your enemies with the devastating power of Thor’s hammer. Shake the ground beneath them and send foes flying with each mighty strike. Take full control of your attacks by adjusting the distance of your Mjolnir throws in real time with precise mouse movements.

Deathmatch

Engage in a free-for-all battle against other warriors.

More in development.

Skål!
